context: Saito explains a mental-health checkup to a patient.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: medical explanation; clinical vocabulary (精神/男性/障害/御) in natural home.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 最近、よく眠れないんです。
lines.style: tired office man voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 精神的な疲れが、出ているようですね。
lines.en: It seems mental fatigue is showing.
lines.style: calm doctor voice, soft warm reassuring measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: これは、何かの障害でしょうか?
lines.en: Is this some kind of disorder?
lines.style: worried office man voice, soft warm anxious delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 重い障害ではありません。御安心下さい。
lines.en: It's not a serious disorder. Please rest assured.
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm reassuring compassionate clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 同年代の男性にも、多いんですか?
lines.en: Is it common among men my age too?
lines.style: curious office man voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 働く男性に、よく見られます。
lines.en: It's often seen in working men.
lines.style: informative doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 自己流で、休んでも大丈夫ですか?
lines.en: Is it okay to rest in my own way?
lines.style: earnest office man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 自己判断より、御相談下さいね。
lines.en: Rather than self-judgment, please consult me.
lines.style: warm doctor voice, soft warm caring closing clarity throughout
